name: Kajikawa (Japan)
description: A yellow field charged at the centre with the Kajikawa village emblem in green: a stylised device of diagonal bars and lozenges, like the character 加.
history: Flag of the former village of Kajikawa in Niigata Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-05-01.

features.role: Kajikawa village emblem — a stylised device of diagonal bars and lozenges, like the character 加
